study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Lin et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Understanding the heterogeneity of dynamic functional connectivity patterns in first-episode drug naïve depression using normative models

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: International Big-Data Center for Depression Research (IBCDR) - a multi-site dataset collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR). Original sample included 1276 MDDs and 1104 healthy controls, from which 274 FEDN-MDDs and 832 healthy controls meeting criteria were selected. The healthy controls were divided into three groups: healthy-ICA (125), healthy-base (289), and healthy-comparison (418).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR).
